leadText:
A Kindler (Japanese: キャンプファイヤー Campfire) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that first debuted in the Generation III games. They are depicted as men in aprons carrying a pair of flaming torches or bundles of wood. They only appear in the Generation III Hoenn-based games and their remakes.

They specialize in Pokémon, which are seemingly used to start fires. Quite often, a member of the or evolutionary line is used. One Kindler uses a , which he possibly uses to put out fires.

====Pokémon====
 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Kindler was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese expansion and the English expansion, with artwork by Hitoshi Ariga. It was also released as a and in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by the same artist. It allows the player to discard a card, then look at the top seven cards of their deck and put up to two of them into their hand.
 

==Trivia==
In Pokémon GO, "Kindler" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 10 Pokémon.
In Pokémon Champions, the title of "Kindler" is awarded for winning ten battles using Pokémon.
